title: Tree Level Sums
statement: A club's hierarchy is a rooted tree. Each member has a value. Print the sum of values on each level, from the root's level downwards.
input_format: The first line contains n. The second line contains the n values of members 1..n. The third line contains n integers: the parent of each member, with 0 for the root.
output_format: Print the level sums separated by spaces.
constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; values are between -10000 and 10000; exactly one root.
hints: Build a list of children for each member from the parent array.
A breadth-first traversal visits the tree level by level.
A chain of 200000 members is a deep tree, so avoid deep recursion.
